input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on your quote
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

Thank you for your quote for RFx KPC-2026-014. We need the following details before we can evaluate it.

Product-specific questions:
1. Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade, RM-002): state the minimum order quantity in kg.
2. Glycerin (RM-002): state the total shelf life and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): your quote says one full lot. State the lot size in kg.
4. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the total shelf life and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Mandatory questionnaire:
5. Provide the Safety Data Sheet for each material you quote, and confirm that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020. This is required before we can proceed.
6. State your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate over the last 12 months, with the supporting data.
7. State your rejection rate over the last 12 months. List the certifications you hold with their expiry dates. Send the renewal certificates as soon as they are issued, with the expected date.
8. Confirm whether you are the manufacturer or a trader. Name the manufacturer and site, and any second source. Confirm whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Quality documents:
9. Please send the Certificate of Analysis for the quoted materials now, not only after an order. We need it to assess the quote.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
